model_tool_workload.measurement_rule: Count product-runtime calls only; coding-agent orchestration is outside this ledger. Use unknown where a run did not measure a field.

core_cache_use.clean_room_rule: cross_run_cache_reads must be zero and any reuse must be current-run and provenance-bound.

prepared_data_reuse.scope_rule: Record exact IDs, effective scope, evidence refs, and whether reuse, extension, fresh creation, no_change, or conflict/supersession occurred.

dashboard_quality.quality_rule: Every displayed KPI or claim must have reviewed item, reviewed output, and evidence/trace provenance.

source_immutability.acceptance_rule: Before/after source hashes match, source_members_modified is zero/false, and prior-run/cross-run reuse is false.

question_order_hash_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes for canonical Q-###|<exact question> lines from questions.md joined by one newline and terminated by one newline.
wall_time_contract: Record only an observed end-to-end measurement from the run harness; otherwise use {status: unknown, observed: false}.
comparison_rule: Do not compare runs unless source hash, question order, clean-room state, and v0.7.0/core0.8.0 markers match.
